title: 🌀 Pseudo-3D Spaces

accepted_baseline.label: Five-scene monumental Spaces engine
preserve: mobile controls cannot trigger text selection/callout UI
Map 5 orange ritual avenue with paired violet spires and stepped temple

current_candidate.summary: Spaces v19 adds proximity-reactive ritual signs to every Map 5 spire. Signs stay hidden below the floor, rise smoothly only when the player is physically close, use separate open/close thresholds to prevent flicker, and retract more slowly after the player moves away.

open_feedback: Review Map 5 sign trigger distance: signs should rise only when the player is clearly close, not from far down the avenue.
Review animation feel: rise should be noticeable and smooth; retract should be slightly slower and should not pop.
Review sign placement: each panel should emerge on the road-facing inner side of its violet spire without blocking the central road.
Preserve all v18 scene geometry, movement and lighting.
